Soony launch team

1. Purpose
This policy defines who may approve purchase orders (POs), supplier releases and air-freight spend.

2. Approval limits by value (per PO, in EUR)
Role                                Limit per PO
Buyer                               < 50,000
Category Lead                       < 500,000
Head of Procurement                 < 2,000,000
Chief Procurement Officer           < 5,000,000
CPO and CFO jointly                 ≥ 5,000,000

3. Receiving site
POs delivered to a Soony site require, in addition to the value approval, a booked dock slot released by the site
lead.
Site                       Site lead                     Deputy
DC-HAM Hamburg             Katrin Jansen                 Raj Patel

4. Air freight
Unplanned air freight up to EUR 200,000 per calendar month and category is approved by the responsible
Category Lead. Above that, approval by the CPO is required before booking.

5. New suppliers
A supplier is released for serial deliveries only after a successful PPAP and written release by the Supplier
Quality Lead and the responsible Category Lead. Conditional releases are limited to 90 days from the date of
release. POs placed after a conditional release has expired are held in status 'awaiting approval'. A conditional
release is extended in writing, once and by at most 90 days, by the responsible Category Lead together with the
Supplier Quality Lead.

6. Exceptions
Exceptions must be documented and approved by the Head of Procurement.
